AI.title_translation: 推进工业4.0：用于3D打印中基于人工智能的故障检测的多模态传感器融合
AI.tldr: 开发了一个低成本、便携式的多模态传感器（声学、振动、热）融合系统，使用CNN实时检测FDM 3D打印中的故障，以推动工业4.0并减少浪费。
AI.motivation: 增材制造（特别是FDM）易受堵塞、断丝和层错位等故障的影响，这些故障会损害打印质量和可靠性。传统的检测方法成本高、耗时长且仅限于后处理分析，不适合实时干预。
AI.method: 该系统整合了声学、振动和热传感数据，采用非侵入式架构。多模态信号被处理成频谱图和时频特征，然后使用卷积神经网络（CNN）进行分类，以实现智能故障检测。
AI.result: 成功开发了一个低成本、便携式的实时监控系统，利用多模态传感器融合和人工智能技术，提高了故障检测的准确性，并支持了工业4.0的实施。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的系统通过提供一种经济、可扩展和实用的监控解决方案，提高了故障检测的准确性，减少了浪费，并支持了可持续的、自适应的制造，从而推动了工业4.0的目标。
AI.translation: 增材制造，特别是熔融沉积成型（FDM），通过实现快速原型制作和复杂零件制造来改变现代生产。然而，其逐层工艺仍然容易出现故障，例如喷嘴堵塞、耗材耗尽和层错位，这些都会损害打印质量和可靠性。传统检测方法成本高昂、耗时，并且通常仅限于后处理分析，因此不适合实时干预。在当前的研究中，作者开发了一种新颖的、低成本的、便携式的故障检测系统，该系统利用多模态传感器融合和人工智能技术对FDM 3D打印进行实时监控。该系统将声学、振动和热传感集成到一个非侵入式架构中，捕获反映机械和过程相关异常的互补数据流。声学和热传感器完全以非接触方式工作，而振动传感器需要最少的连接，这样它就不会干扰打印机硬件，从而保持了便携性和易于部署的特性。多模态信号被处理成频谱图和时频特征，然后使用卷积神经网络进行分类，以实现智能故障检测。所提出的系统通过提供经济、可扩展和实用的监控解决方案，提高了故障检测准确性，减少了浪费，并支持了可持续的、自适应的制造，从而推进了工业4.0的目标。
AI.summary: 本研究开发了一种创新的、低成本的便携式系统，利用声学、振动和热传感器的多模态融合，结合卷积神经网络，对熔融沉积成型（FDM）3D打印过程中的故障进行实时检测和监控，以提高打印质量和制造可持续性。
AI.keywords: 3D打印, 工业4.0, 多模态传感器融合, 故障检测, 卷积神经网络
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一种低成本、便携式、非侵入性的多模态传感器融合系统，用于对FDM 3D打印过程中的故障进行实时检测。其重要性在于它直接解决了传统检测方法的成本高、耗时长和无法实时干预的局限性，支持了工业4.0的目标。局限性方面，抽象中未明确提及，但可推测其性能可能依赖于所选传感器的质量和特征工程的有效性。

title: In-Situ Analysis of Vibration and Acoustic Data in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Vibration from an erroneous disturbance harms the manufactured components and lowers the output quality of an FDM printer. For moving machinery, vibration analysis and control are crucial. Additive manufacturing is the basis of 3D printing, which utilizes mechanical movement of the extruder to fabricate objects, and faults occur due to unwanted vibrations. Therefore, it is vital to examine the vibration patterns of a 3D printer. In this work, we observe these parameters of an FDM printer, exemplified by the MakerBot Method X. To analyze the system, it is necessary to understand the motion it generates and select appropriate sensors to detect those motions. The sensor measurement values can be used to determine the condition of the printer. We used an accelerometer and an acoustic sensor to measure the vibration and sound produced by the printer. The outputs from these sensors were examined individually. The findings show that vibration occurs at relatively low levels during continuous motion because it mainly appears at component transition edges. Due to abrupt acceleration and deceleration during zigzag motion, vibration reaches its peak.

AI.title_translation: 增材制造中振动和声学数据的原位分析
AI.tldr: 本研究通过对FDM打印机（MakerBot Method X）的振动和声学数据进行原位分析，发现振动主要发生在部件过渡边缘和锯齿运动的急剧加减速时达到峰值，以期理解并控制3D打印过程中的振动。
AI.motivation: 错误的扰动引起的振动会损害制造成品并降低FDM打印机的输出质量。由于增材制造（3D打印）过程中挤出机的机械运动会产生不必要的振动，因此检查3D打印机的振动模式至关重要。
AI.method: 研究人员通过观察一台FDM打印机（MakerBot Method X）的振动和声学参数。使用加速度计和声学传感器测量打印机产生的振动和声音，并对传感器输出进行单独检查。
AI.result: 研究发现，在连续运动期间，振动水平相对较低，主要出现在部件过渡边缘。在锯齿运动中，由于急剧的加减速，振动达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过对FDM打印机的振动和声学数据进行原位分析，揭示了振动模式与运动状态的关系，为未来振动控制和打印质量提升提供了基础。
AI.translation: 来自错误扰动的振动会损害制造成品并降低FDM打印机的输出质量。对于移动机械而言，振动分析和控制至关重要。增材制造是3D打印的基础，它利用挤出机的机械运动来制造物体，并且由于不必要的振动会发生故障。因此，检查3D打印机的振动模式至关重要。在这项工作中，我们观察了FDM打印机的这些参数，以MakerBot Method X为例。为了分析系统，有必要了解它产生的运动并选择合适的传感器来检测这些运动。传感器测量值可用于确定打印机的状况。我们使用加速度计和声学传感器来测量打印机产生的振动和声音。对这些传感器的输出进行了单独检查。研究结果表明，在连续运动期间，振动水平相对较低，因为它主要出现在部件过渡边缘。由于锯齿运动期间的急剧加减速，振动达到峰值。
AI.summary: 本研究对增材制造（FDM打印机，以MakerBot Method X为例）中的振动和声学数据进行原位分析。通过使用加速度计和声学传感器测量打印机的振动和声音，研究发现振动在连续运动时水平较低，主要出现在部件过渡边缘，而在锯齿运动中因急剧加减速而达到峰值。这对于理解和控制3D打印过程中的振动至关重要，以提高产品质量。
AI.keywords: 增材制造, 振动分析, 声学数据, FDM打印机, 原位监测
AI.comments: 该论文通过对FDM打印机进行原位振动和声学分析，揭示了不同运动模式下振动的特征，具有实际应用价值。其创新点在于结合振动和声学数据来诊断3D打印机的运行状况，为优化打印过程和提高产品质量提供了数据支持。局限性可能在于仅考察了一种型号的打印机，且未深入探讨具体的振动抑制策略。

title: Pinching Antennas-Aided Integrated Sensing and Multicast Communication Systems
summary: A pinching antennas (PAs)-aided integrated sensing and multicast communication framework is proposed. In this framework, the communication performance is measured by the multicast rate considering max-min fairness. Moreover, the sensing performance is quantified by the Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound (BCRB), where a Gauss-Hermite quadrature-based approach is proposed to compute the Bayesian Fisher information matrix. Based on these metrics, PA placement is optimized under three criteria: communications-centric (C-C), sensing-centric (S-C), and Pareto-optimal designs. These designs are investigated in two scenarios: the single-PA case and the multi-PA case. 1) For the single-PA case, a closed-form solution is derived for the location of the C-C transmit PA, while the S-C design yields optimal transmit and receive PA placements that are symmetric about the target location. Leveraging this geometric insight, the Pareto-optimal design is solved by enforcing this PA placement symmetry, thereby reducing the joint transmit and receive PA placement to the transmit PA optimization. 2) For the general multi-PA case, the PA placements constitute a highly non-convex optimization problem. To solve this, an element-wise alternating optimization-based method is proposed to sequentially optimize all PA placements for the S-C design, and is further incorporated into an augmented Lagrangian (AL) framework and a rate-profile formulation to solve the C-C and Pareto-optimal design problems, respectively. Numerical results show that: i) PASS substantially outperforms fixed-antenna baselines in both multicast rate and sensing accuracy; ii) the multicasting gain becomes more pronounced as the user density increases; and iii) the sensing accuracy improves with the number of deployed PAs.

AI.title_translation: 夹紧天线辅助的集成感知与组播通信系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个夹紧天线辅助的集成感知与组播通信框架，并优化了天线布局以提高通信速率和感知精度。
AI.motivation: 提出一个夹紧天线（PAs）辅助的集成感知与组播通信框架，旨在优化系统性能，特别是在通信和感知方面。
AI.method: 提出了夹紧天线（PAs）辅助的集成感知与组播通信框架。通信性能通过考虑最大最小公平性的组播速率衡量，感知性能通过贝叶斯克拉默-劳界（BCRB）量化，并采用高斯-埃尔米特正交方法计算贝叶斯费舍尔信息矩阵。PA布局在通信中心（C-C）、感知中心（S-C）和帕累托最优三种准则下进行优化。对于单PA情况，推导了C-C发射PA位置的闭式解，S-C设计得到对称的最优发射和接收PA布局，并利用该对称性解决帕累托最优设计。对于多PA情况，提出了基于逐元素交替优化的方法解决S-C设计的非凸PA布局问题，并将其结合到增强拉格朗日（AL）框架和速率剖面公式中以解决C-C和帕累托最优设计问题。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：i）PA系统在组播速率和感知精度方面显著优于固定天线基线；ii）随着用户密度的增加，组播增益变得更加明显；iii）感知精度随着部署的PA数量的增加而提高。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的夹紧天线辅助的集成感知与组播通信系统，通过优化PA布局，能够显著提升通信速率和感知精度，尤其是在多用户和多PA部署场景下表现出优越性。
AI.translation: 提出了一个夹紧天线（PAs）辅助的集成感知与组播通信框架。在此框架中，通信性能通过考虑最大最小公平性的组播速率来衡量。此外，感知性能通过贝叶斯克拉默-劳界（BCRB）进行量化，其中提出了一种基于高斯-埃尔米特正交的方法来计算贝叶斯费舍尔信息矩阵。基于这些指标，在三种准则下优化了PA布局：通信中心（C-C）、感知中心（S-C）和帕累托最优设计。这些设计在两种场景中进行了研究：单PA情况和多PA情况。1）对于单PA情况，推导出了C-C发射PA位置的闭式解，而S-C设计产生了关于目标位置对称的最优发射和接收PA布局。利用这种几何洞察力，通过强制这种PA布局对称性来解决帕累托最优设计，从而将联合发射和接收PA布局简化为发射PA优化。2）对于一般多PA情况，PA布局构成一个高度非凸的优化问题。为了解决这个问题，提出了一种基于逐元素交替优化的方法，用于顺序优化S-C设计的所有PA布局，并进一步将其纳入增强拉格朗日（AL）框架和速率剖面公式中，分别解决C-C和帕累托最优设计问题。数值结果表明：i）PA系统在组播速率和感知精度方面显著优于固定天线基线；ii）随着用户密度的增加，组播增益变得更加明显；iii）感知精度随着部署的PA数量的增加而提高。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于夹紧天线（PAs）的集成感知与组播通信系统框架。该框架以最大最小公平组播速率和贝叶斯克拉默-劳界（BCRB）作为通信和感知性能指标，并针对单PA和多PA场景，在通信中心、感知中心和帕累托最优准则下优化PA布局。研究推导了单PA情况下的闭式解和对称性，并为多PA情况设计了基于交替优化和增强拉格朗日的方法。数值结果验证了所提系统在组播速率和感知精度上优于基线，且性能随用户密度和PA数量增加而提升。
AI.keywords: 夹紧天线, 集成感知与通信, 组播通信, 贝叶斯克拉默-劳界, 优化设计
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了夹紧天线（PAs）辅助的集成感知与组播通信框架，并针对PA布局优化问题，在单PA和多PA场景下设计了多种优化准则和算法。特别是针对多PA布局的非凸优化问题，提出了逐元素交替优化结合增强拉格朗日框架的解决方案，具有较高的技术含量。该研究对于未来集成感知与通信系统的天线设计和资源管理具有重要指导意义。

title: SeaSpoofFinder -- Potential GNSS Spoofing Event Detection Using AIS
summary: This paper investigates whether large-scale GNSS spoofing activity can be inferred from maritime Automatic Identification System (AIS) position reports. A data-processing framework, called SeaSpoofFinder, available here: seaspooffinder.github.io/ais_data, was developed to ingest and post-process global AIS streams and to detect candidate anomalies through a two-stage procedure. In Stage 1, implausible position jumps are identified using kinematic and data-quality filters; in Stage 2, events are retained only when multiple vessels exhibit spatially consistent source and target clustering, thereby reducing false positives from single-vessel artifacts. The resulting final potential spoofing events (FPSEs) reveal recurrent patterns in several regions, including the Baltic Sea, the Black Sea, Murmansk, Moscow, and the Haifa area, with affected footprints that can span large maritime areas. The analysis also highlights recurring non-spoofing artifacts (e.g., back-to-port jumps and data gaps) that can still pass heuristic filters in dense traffic regions. These results indicate that AIS-based monitoring can provide useful evidence for identifying and characterizing potential spoofing activity at scale, while emphasizing that AIS-only evidence does not provide definitive attribution.

AI.title_translation: 利用自动识别系统（AIS）检测潜在的全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）欺骗事件
AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个名为SeaSpoofFinder的框架，通过分析全球AIS数据来检测大规模GNSS欺骗事件。该框架通过识别不合理的位移跳跃和多艘船只的空间一致性聚类来筛选潜在欺骗事件，并在波罗的海、黑海、摩尔曼斯克、莫斯科和海法地区发现了重复出现的模式。研究表明，基于AIS的监测可以为识别和表征大规模潜在欺骗活动提供证据，但不能提供最终的归因。
AI.motivation: 研究大规模GNSS欺骗活动是否可以通过海上自动识别系统（AIS）的航位报告来推断。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为SeaSpoofFinder的数据处理框架，该框架通过两阶段程序（包括运动学和数据质量过滤，以及多艘船只的空间一致性聚类）来处理全球AIS数据流，以检测潜在的欺骗事件。
AI.result: 在波罗的海、黑海、摩尔曼斯克、莫斯科和海法等地区发现了潜在的欺骗事件，这些事件具有可跨越广阔海域的特征。同时，研究还识别出可能被误判为欺骗事件的非欺骗性伪影（例如，靠港跳跃和数据缺失）。
AI.conclusion: 基于AIS的监测可以为识别和表征大规模的潜在GNSS欺骗活动提供有用的证据，但仅凭AIS证据无法做出最终的归因。
AI.translation: 本论文研究了是否可以从海上自动识别系统（AIS）的航位报告中推断出大规模的GNSS欺骗活动。开发了一个名为SeaSpoofFinder的数据处理框架（可在此处获取：seaspooffinder.github.io/ais_data），用于接收和后处理全球AIS数据流，并通过两阶段程序检测候选异常。在第一阶段，使用运动学和数据质量过滤器识别出不合理的航位跳跃；在第二阶段，仅当多艘船只表现出空间上一致的源和目标聚类时，才保留事件，从而减少由单艘船只伪影引起的误报。由此产生的最终潜在欺骗事件（FPSEs）在几个地区揭示了重复出现的模式，包括波罗的海、黑海、摩尔曼斯克、莫斯科和海法地区，受影响的范围可跨越广阔的海域。分析还突出了在密集交通区域可能仍会通过启发式过滤器的重复出现的非欺骗性伪影（例如，靠港跳跃和数据缺失）。这些结果表明，基于AIS的监测可以为大规模识别和表征潜在的欺骗活动提供有用的证据，同时强调仅凭AIS证据无法提供确切的归因。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一种名为SeaSpoofFinder的框架，该框架利用全球AIS数据来检测大规模GNSS欺骗事件。通过两阶段分析，包括识别异常航位变化和验证多艘船只的空间一致性，该系统成功识别出在多个地区（如波罗的海、黑海等）反复出现的潜在欺骗模式，其影响范围可达大片海域。研究同时指出了可能被误判的非欺骗性数据异常，并强调AIS数据可作为欺骗活动监测的有力证据，但不能作为最终归因的依据。
AI.keywords: GNSS欺骗, AIS, SeaSpoofFinder, 航位异常检测, 海上监测
AI.comments: 该研究开创性地利用AIS数据来检测大规模GNSS欺骗活动，为海上安全监测提供了一种新的视角。SeaSpoofFinder框架的两阶段检测方法有效地平衡了检测能力和误报率，具有实际应用价值。然而，研究也坦诚地指出了AIS数据在最终归因方面的局限性，这为未来的研究提供了方向，例如结合其他传感器数据以提高欺骗事件的确定性。

title: Impact of Preprocessing on Neural Network-Based RSS/AoA Positioning
summary: Hybrid received signal strength (RSS)-angle of arrival (AoA)-based positioning offers low-cost distance estimation and high-resolution angular measurements. Still, it comes at a cost of inherent nonlinearities, geometry-dependent noise, and suboptimal weighting in conventional linear estimators that might limit accuracy. In this paper, we propose a neural network-based approach using a multilayer perceptron (MLP) to directly map RSS-AoA measurements to 3D positions, capturing nonlinear relationships that are difficult to model with traditional methods. We evaluate the impact of input representation by comparing networks trained on raw measurements versus preprocessed features derived from a linearization method. Simulation results show that the learning-based approach consistently outperforms existing linear methods under RSS noise across all noise levels, and matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance under increasing AoA noise. Furthermore, preprocessing measurements using the linearization method provides a clear advantage over raw data, demonstrating the benefit of geometry-aware feature extraction.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络定位中预处理的影响
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于多层感知器（MLP）的神经网络方法，用于直接从接收信号强度（RSS）和到达角（AoA）测量值映射到3D位置，以解决传统线性估计器中的非线性、几何依赖噪声和次优加权问题。结果表明，与现有线性方法相比，该学习方法在RSS噪声下表现更好，在AoA噪声下表现相当或更好。使用线性化方法进行预处理可以提供比原始数据更优越的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于RSS/AoA的定位方法存在非线性、几何依赖噪声和次优加权等问题，限制了定位精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多层感知器（MLP）的神经网络方法，直接将RSS-AoA测量值映射到3D位置。比较了直接使用原始测量值和使用线性化方法预处理后的特征进行训练的网络性能。
AI.result: 与现有线性方法相比，基于学习的方法在所有RSS噪声水平下均表现出优越的性能。在AoA噪声增加的情况下，其性能与最先进的方法相当或更优。使用线性化方法进行预处理比使用原始数据具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络方法能够有效解决传统RSS/AoA定位方法的局限性，并且通过几何感知特征提取进行预处理可以进一步提高定位性能。
AI.translation: 混合接收信号强度（RSS）-到达角（AoA）定位提供低成本的距离估计和高分辨率的角度测量。然而，它也存在传统线性估计器中固有的非线性、几何依赖噪声以及可能限制精度的次优加权等问题。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于神经网络的方法，使用多层感知器（MLP）直接将RSS-AoA测量值映射到3D位置，从而捕捉传统方法难以建模的非线性关系。我们通过比较在原始测量值和源自线性化方法的预处理特征上训练的网络，来评估输入表示的影响。仿真结果表明，在所有噪声水平下，该学习方法在RSS噪声下始终优于现有的线性方法，并且在AoA噪声增加的情况下，性能与最先进的方法相当或更优。此外，使用线性化方法对测量值进行预处理，比原始数据具有明显的优势，证明了几何感知特征提取的好处。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于多层感知器（MLP）的神经网络方法，用于直接从RSS和AoA测量值定位到3D位置。该方法旨在解决传统线性定位方法中存在的非线性、几何依赖噪声和次优加权问题。通过仿真实验，结果表明该神经网络方法在各种噪声条件下均优于或媲美现有方法，并且使用线性化方法进行预处理可以进一步提升性能。
AI.keywords: RSS/AoA定位, 神经网络, 多层感知器, 预处理, 特征提取
AI.comments: 该研究有效地将神经网络应用于解决传统的RSS/AoA定位问题，并取得了令人鼓舞的结果。预处理方法的研究为提高定位精度提供了有价值的见解。

title: Joint beamforming and mode optimization for multi-functional STAR-RIS-aided integrated sensing and communication networks
summary: This paper investigates the design of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems assisted by simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (STAR-RISs), which act as multi-functional programmable metasurfaces capable of supporting concurrent communication and sensing within a unified architecture. We propose a two-stage ISAC protocol, in which the preparation phase performs direction estimation for outdoor users located in the reflection space, while maintaining communication with both outdoor and indoor users in the transmission space. The subsequent communication phase exploits the estimated directions to enhance information transfer. The directions of outdoor users are modeled as Gaussian random variables to capture estimation uncertainty, and the corresponding average communication performance is incorporated into the design. Building on this framework, we formulate a performance-balanced optimization problem that maximizes the communication sum-rate while guaranteeing the required sensing accuracy, jointly determining the beamforming vectors at the base station (BS), the STAR-RIS transmission and reflection coefficients, and the metasurface partition between energy-splitting and transmit-only modes. The physical constraints of STAR-RIS elements and the required sensing performance are explicitly enforced. To address the non-convex nature of the problem, we combine fractional programming, Lagrangian dual reformulation, and successive convex approximation. The binary metasurface partition is ultimately recovered via continuous relaxation followed by projection-based binarization. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed design achieves an effective trade-off between sensing accuracy and communication throughput, by significantly outperforming conventional STAR-RIS-aided ISAC schemes.

AI.title_translation: 多功能STAR-RIS辅助集成感知与通信网络的联合波束赋形和模式优化
AI.tldr: 为了在STAR-RIS辅助的ISAC系统中平衡通信速率和感知精度，本文提出了一种两阶段优化方案，该方案考虑了方向估计的不确定性，并使用先进的优化技术（如分数规划和序列凸近似）来联合优化波束赋形、RIS系数和模式分区，结果显示性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 研究在统一架构下，利用STAR-RIS作为多功能可编程超表面，以支持并发通信和感知的集成感知与通信 (ISAC) 系统的设计。目标是在保证所需感知精度的同时，最大化通信和速率。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段ISAC协议：准备阶段进行方向估计并保持通信；通信阶段利用估计的方向增强信息传输。通过分数规划、拉格朗日对偶重构和序列凸近似来解决联合优化问题，并通过连续松弛和基于投影的二值化来恢复二进制超表面分区。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提出的设计通过显著优于传统的STAR-RIS辅助ISAC方案，实现了感知精度和通信吞吐量之间的有效权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的设计实现了感知精度和通信吞吐量之间的有效权衡，并且显著优于传统的STAR-RIS辅助ISAC方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究了由同时传输和反射的可重构智能表面（STAR-RISs）辅助的集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统的设计，STAR-RISs充当能够支持并发通信和感知的多功能可编程超表面。我们提出了一种两阶段ISAC协议，其中准备阶段对反射空间中的室外用户进行方向估计，同时与传输空间中的室内外用户保持通信。随后的通信阶段利用估计的方向来增强信息传输。将室外用户的方向建模为高斯随机变量以捕捉估计不确定性，并将相应的平均通信性能纳入设计中。在此框架的基础上，我们制定了一个性能平衡的优化问题，该问题在保证所需感知精度的同时最大化通信和速率，联合确定基站（BS）处的波束赋形向量、STAR-RIS的传输和反射系数，以及在能量分裂和仅传输模式之间的超表面分区。明确执行了STAR-RIS元件的物理约束和所需的感知性能。为解决问题的非凸性，我们将分数规划、拉格朗日对偶重构和序列凸近似相结合。最终通过连续松弛和基于投影的二值化来恢复二进制超表面分区。数值结果表明，所提出的设计通过显著优于传统的STAR-RIS辅助ISAC方案，实现了感知精度和通信吞吐量之间的有效权衡。
AI.summary: 本文研究了由STAR-RIS辅助的集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统。提出了一种两阶段协议，包括利用方向估计来增强通信和感知，同时考虑了估计不确定性。通过联合优化波束赋形、STAR-RIS系数和超表面分区，构建了一个在满足感知精度要求下最大化通信和速率的性能平衡优化问题，并采用分数规划等方法求解，最终实现了通信与感知的有效权衡。
AI.keywords: STAR-RIS,集成感知与通信 (ISAC),联合波束赋形,模式优化,分数规划
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个联合波束赋形和模式优化的两阶段协议，以解决STAR-RIS辅助ISAC系统中通信速率与感知精度的平衡问题。该方法通过考虑室外用户方向估计的不确定性，并采用分数规划、拉格朗日对偶和序列凸近似的联合优化技术，有效处理了非凸问题。然而，其局限性可能在于对高斯随机变量的建模假设以及在实际复杂环境中的性能验证。

title: Reconstruction of Piecewise-Constant Sparse Signals for Modulo Sampling
comments: This work will be submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Modulo sampling is a promising technology to preserve amplitude information that exceeds the observable range of analog-to-digital converters during the digitization of analog signals. Since conventional methods typically reconstruct the original signal by estimating the differences of the residual signal and computing their cumulative sum, each estimation error inevitably propagates through subsequent time samples. In this paper, to eliminate this error-propagation problem, we propose an algorithm that reconstructs the residual signal directly. The proposed method takes advantage of the high-frequency characteristics of the modulo samples and the sparsity of both the residual signal and its difference. Simulation results show that the proposed method reconstructs the original signal more accurately than a conventional method based on the differences of the residual signal.
comment: This work will be submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 分段常数稀疏信号的模采样重建
AI.tldr: 提出了一种直接重建残差信号的算法，利用模采样的高频特性以及残差信号及其差分的稀疏性，解决了传统方法中估计误差传播的问题，重建精度优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统模采样信号重建方法通过估计残差信号的差分并累积求和来重建原始信号，但这种方法会导致估计误差在后续时间样本中传播。本研究旨在消除这种误差传播问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种直接重建残差信号的算法。该方法利用模采样的高频特性以及残差信号及其差分的稀疏性。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方法比基于残差信号差分的传统方法能更精确地重建原始信号。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的直接重建残差信号的算法成功地解决了模采样信号重建中的误差传播问题，并提高了重建精度。
AI.translation: 模采样是一种有前途的技术，可在模拟信号数字化过程中保留超出模数转换器可观测范围的幅度信息。由于传统方法通常通过估计残差信号的差分并计算其累积和来重建原始信号，因此每次估计误差都不可避免地会传播到后续时间样本。在本文中，为了消除这种误差传播问题，我们提出了一种直接重建残差信号的算法。该方法利用了模采样的高频特性以及残差信号及其差分的稀疏性。仿真结果表明，与基于残差信号差分的传统方法相比，所提出的方法能够更准确地重建原始信号。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的模采样信号重建算法，直接重建残差信号以克服传统方法中误差传播的问题。该算法利用了模采样的高频特性和信号的稀疏性，并通过仿真证明其重建精度优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 模采样, 信号重建, 稀疏信号, 误差传播, 残差信号
AI.comments: 该研究解决了模采样信号重建中的一个关键挑战——误差传播。通过直接重建残差信号并利用信号的稀疏性和模采样的高频特性，该方法在理论和实践上都具有潜力。然而，算法的计算复杂度和在不同噪声环境下的鲁棒性有待进一步评估。

title: Proof of Concept: Local TX Real-Time Phase Calibration in MIMO Systems
summary: Channel measurements in MIMO systems hinge on precise synchronization. While methods for time and frequency synchronization are well established, maintaining real-time phase coherence remains an open requirement for many MIMO systems. Phase coherence in MIMO systems is crucial for beamforming in digital arrays and enables precise parameter estimates such as Angle-of-Arrival/Departure. This work presents and validates a simple local real-time phase calibration method for a digital array. We compare two different approaches, instantaneous and smoothed calibration, to determine the optimal interval between synchronization procedures. To quantitatively assess calibration performance, we use two metrics: the average beamforming power loss and the RMS cycle-to-cycle jitter. Our results indicate that both approaches for phase calibration are effective and yield RMS of jitter in the 2.1 ps to 124 fs range for different SDR models. This level of precision enables coherent transmission on commonly available SDR platforms, allowing investigation on advanced MIMO techniques and transmit beamforming in practical testbeds.

AI.title_translation: 概念验证：MIMO系统中的本地传输实时相位校准
AI.tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一种用于数字阵列的简单本地实时相位校准方法，解决了MIMO系统中的相位相干性问题，并提供了两种校准方法的性能评估。
AI.motivation: MIMO系统中的相位相干性对于波束成形和精确参数估计至关重要，但目前仍是未解决的需求。
AI.method: 提出并比较了两种局部实时相位校准方法：瞬时校准和平滑校准，并使用平均波束成形功率损耗和均方根周期-周期抖动作为评估指标。
AI.result: 两种相位校准方法均有效，不同SDR模型的抖动均方根值在2.1 ps至124 fs之间。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的局部实时相位校准方法能够实现常见SDR平台上的相干传输，为实际测试平台上的高级MIMO技术和传输波束成形研究提供了可能。
AI.translation: MIMO系统中的信道测量依赖于精确的同步。虽然时间和频率同步的方法已经很成熟，但保持实时相位相干性仍然是许多MIMO系统的未满足需求。MIMO系统中的相位相干性对于数字阵列中的波束成形至关重要，并能够实现到达角/离去角等精确参数估计。这项工作提出并验证了一种用于数字阵列的简单局部实时相位校准方法。我们比较了两种不同的方法：瞬时校准和平滑校准，以确定同步程序之间的最佳间隔。为了定量评估校准性能，我们使用了两个指标：平均波束成形功率损耗和均方根周期-周期抖动。我们的结果表明，两种相位校准方法均有效，对于不同的SDR模型，抖动均方根值在2.1 ps至124 fs的范围内。这种精度水平使得在常见的SDR平台上能够进行相干传输，从而可以在实际测试平台上研究高级MIMO技术和传输波束成形。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于MIMO系统的局部实时相位校准方法，解决了相位相干性问题。该方法通过瞬时校准和瞬时校准两种方式实现，并使用功率损耗和抖动作为评估指标。结果表明该方法有效，可实现高精度相干传输。
AI.keywords: MIMO,相位校准,实时同步,波束成形,SDR
AI.comments: 该研究提出的局部实时相位校准方法为MIMO系统中的相位相干性问题提供了一个简单有效的解决方案。其创新之处在于直接在本地进行实时校准，避免了传统方法的复杂性。方法的有效性通过量化指标得到验证，为实际应用提供了依据。然而，文中未提及校准方法的计算复杂度以及在不同环境噪声下的鲁棒性，这可能是未来研究可以关注的方向。

title: Failure-Aware Access Point Selection for Resilient Cell-Free Massive MIMO Networks
summary: This paper presents a Failure-Aware Access Point Selection (FAAS) method aimed at improving hardware resilience in cell-free massive MIMO (CF-mMIMO) networks. FAAS selects APs for each user by jointly considering channel strength and the failure probability of each AP. A tunable parameter \(α\in [0,1]\) scales these failure probabilities to model different levels of network stress. We evaluate resilience using two key metrics: the minimum-user spectral efficiency, which captures worst-case user performance, and the outage probability, defined as the fraction of users left without any active APs. Simulation results show that FAAS maintains significantly better performance under failure conditions compared to failure-agnostic clustering. At high failure levels, FAAS reduces outage by over 85\% and improves worst-case user rates. These results confirm that FAAS is a practical and efficient solution for building more reliable CF-mMIMO networks.

AI.title_translation: 面向弹性蜂窝网络的故障感知接入点选择
AI.tldr: 为了让蜂窝网络更可靠，我们提出了一种新的AP选择方法（FAAS），它不仅看信号强度，还看AP会不会坏。在模拟的故障场景中，这种方法能将用户无法连接的情况减少85%以上，效果非常好。
AI.motivation: 提高蜂窝网络（CF-mMIMO）中的硬件弹性。
AI.method: FAAS方法通过联合考虑每个接入点（AP）的信道强度和故障概率来为每个用户选择AP。引入一个可调参数 $\alpha\in [0,1]$ 来缩放故障概率，以模拟不同程度的网络压力。
AI.result: 在故障条件下，FAAS相对于无故障感知的聚类方法，性能显著更好。在高故障水平下，FAAS将中断率降低了超过85%，并提高了最差用户的速率。
AI.conclusion: FAAS是一种实用且高效的解决方案，可用于构建更可靠的蜂窝网络（CF-mMIMO）系统。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种旨在提高蜂窝网络（CF-mMIMO）中硬件弹性的故障感知接入点选择（FAAS）方法。FAAS通过联合考虑每个AP的信道强度和故障概率来为每个用户选择AP。一个可调参数 $\alpha\in [0,1]$ 用于缩放这些故障概率，以模拟不同程度的网络压力。我们使用两个关键指标来评估弹性：捕获最差用户性能的最小用户频谱效率，以及定义为没有活动AP的用户比例的出错概率。仿真结果表明，在故障条件下，与无故障感知的聚类方法相比，FAAS保持了显著更好的性能。在高故障水平下，FAAS将中断率降低了超过85%，并提高了最差用户的速率。这些结果证实了FAAS是构建更可靠的蜂窝网络的一种实用且高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种故障感知接入点选择（FAAS）方法，用于增强蜂窝网络（CF-mMIMO）的硬件弹性。FAAS通过联合优化信道强度和AP的故障概率来选择AP，并使用参数 $\alpha$ 来调节压力水平。仿真表明，FAAS在故障条件下显著优于现有方法，大幅降低了中断率并提高了最差用户的性能。
AI.keywords: 故障感知, 接入点选择, 蜂窝网络, 海量MIMO, 网络弹性
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于将AP的失效概率纳入接入点选择决策中，从而增强了网络在硬件故障条件下的鲁棒性。它提供了一种可调的机制（参数α）来平衡信道质量和可靠性。该方法在解决CF-mMIMO网络中的实际硬件弹性问题方面具有重要意义。限制是仅基于所提出的两种性能指标进行评估。

title: WindDensity-MBIR: Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction for Wind Tunnel 3D Density Estimation
comments: Submitted to the Unconventional Imaging, Sensing, and Adaptive Optics special session of Optical Engineering
summary: Experimentalists often use wind tunnels to study aerodynamic turbulence, but most wind tunnel imaging techniques are limited in their ability to take non-invasive 3D density measurements of turbulence. Wavefront tomography is a technique that uses multiple wavefront measurements from various viewing angles to non-invasively measure the 3D density field of a turbulent medium. Existing methods make strong assumptions, such as a spline basis representation, to address the ill-conditioned nature of this problem. We formulate this problem as a Bayesian, sparse-view tomographic reconstruction problem and develop a model-based iterative reconstruction algorithm for measuring the volumetric 3D density field inside a wind tunnel. We call this method WindDensity-MBIR and apply it using simulated data to difficult reconstruction scenarios with sparse data, small projection field of view, and limited angular extent. WindDensity-MBIR can recover high-order features in these scenarios within 10% to 25% error even when the tip, tilt, and piston are removed from the wavefront measurements.
comment: Submitted to the Unconventional Imaging, Sensing, and Adaptive Optics special session of Optical Engineering

AI.title_translation: 风洞三维密度估计的基于模型的迭代重建
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为WindDensity-MBIR的新方法，用于解决风洞湍流三维密度测量的难题。该方法采用基于贝叶斯的稀疏视角断层重建算法，能够在数据稀疏、视野小和角度有限等挑战性场景下，准确地重建三维密度场，误差在10%-25%之间，即使在去除波前测量中的倾斜和活塞项后仍能有效工作。
AI.motivation: 现有的风洞成像技术在非侵入式三维密度测量方面存在局限性，而三维密度测量对于研究空气动力学湍流至关重要。现有方法为了解决病态问题，通常会做出强假设（如样条基表示），这可能限制其准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯稀疏视角断层重建的框架，并开发了一种基于模型的迭代重建算法（WindDensity-MBIR），用于测量风洞内部的体积三维密度场。
AI.result: 在稀疏数据、小投影视场和小角度范围的挑战性重建场景下，WindDensity-MBIR能够恢复高阶特征，误差在10%至25%之间，即使在移除了波前测量中的倾斜和活塞项后依然有效。
AI.conclusion: WindDensity-MBIR 算法能够有效解决稀疏视角断层重建问题，在具有挑战性的风洞湍流密度测量场景下表现出色，并能在一定程度上容忍测量噪声和不完整性。
AI.translation: 实验者通常使用风洞来研究空气动力学湍流，但大多数风洞成像技术在非侵入式测量湍流三维密度场的能力方面存在局限性。波前断层扫描术是一种利用来自不同视角的多个波前测量来非侵入式测量湍流介质的三维密度场的技.现有方法为了解决该问题的病态性质，做出了强假设，例如样条基表示。我们将此问题构建为一个贝叶斯稀疏视角断层重建问题，并开发了一种基于模型的迭代重建算法，用于测量风洞内部的体积三维密度场。我们将此方法称为WindDensity-MBIR，并将其应用于模拟数据，以应对数据稀疏、投影视场小和角度范围有限的困难重建场景。即使在从波前测量中移除倾斜和活塞项后，WindDensity-MBIR 在这些场景下仍能在 10% 到 25% 的误差范围内恢复高阶特征。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为WindDensity-MBIR的基于模型的迭代重建算法，用于解决风洞湍流三维密度测量的挑战。该方法将问题构建为贝叶斯稀疏视角断层重建问题，即使在数据稀疏、视野有限等困难条件下，也能在10%-25%的误差范围内有效重建三维密度场。
AI.keywords: 风洞, 三维密度估计, 模型驱动迭代重建, 波前断层扫描, 稀疏视角
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的基于模型的迭代重建算法（WindDensity-MBIR），解决了风洞湍流三维密度测量的关键挑战。其优势在于能够处理稀疏数据和有限视角等实际限制，并在模拟数据中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，在实际应用中的鲁棒性和计算效率仍需进一步验证。

title: Active RIS-Assisted MIMO System for Vital Signs Extraction: ISAC Modeling, Deep Learning, and Prototype Measurements
summary: We present the RIS-VSign system, an active reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) framework for vital signs extraction under an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) model. The system consists of two stages: the phase selector of RIS and the extraction of respiration rate. To mitigate synchronization-induced common phase drifts, the difference of Möbius transformation (DMT) is integrated into the deep learning framework, named DMTNet, to jointly configure multiple active RIS elements. Notably, the training data are generated in simulation without collecting real-world measurements, and the resulting phase selector is validated experimentally. For sensing, multi-antenna measurements are fused by the DC-offset calibration and the DeepMining-MMV processing with CA-CFAR detection and Newton's refinements. Prototype experiments indicate that active RIS deployment improves respiration detectability while simultaneously enabling higher-order modulation; without RIS, respiration detection is unreliable and only lower-order modulation is supported.

AI.title_translation: 基于主动式可重构智能面辅助的多输入多输出系统，用于生命体征提取：集成感知与通信模型、深度学习及原型测量
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为RIS-VSign的主动式RIS辅助MIMO-OFDM系统，用于在ISAC模型下提取生命体征。系统通过一个相位选择器和一个呼吸率提取模块组成。为了解决同步引起的相位漂移问题，研究人员将Möbius变换差分（DMT）集成到一个名为DMTNet的深度学习框架中，用于联合配置多个主动式RIS单元。虽然训练数据来自模拟，但相位选择器得到了实验验证。在感知方面，通过DC偏移校准和DeepMining-MMV处理（包括CA-CFAR检测和牛顿优化）融合了多天线测量数据。原型实验表明，主动式RIS的部署能够提高呼吸可探测性并支持更高阶的调制，而没有RIS时，呼吸检测不可靠且仅支持低阶调制。
AI.motivation: 在集成感知与通信（ISAC）模型下，开发一个能够有效提取生命体征，特别是呼吸率的系统，并解决同步引起的相位漂移问题，同时提升通信性能。
AI.method: 提出RIS-VSign系统，一个主动式RIS辅助MIMO-OFDM框架。该系统包含两个阶段：RIS的相位选择器和呼吸率提取。为了解决同步引起的相位漂移，将Möbius变换差分（DMT）集成到名为DMTNet的深度学习框架中，用于联合配置多个主动式RIS单元。感知阶段采用DC偏移校准和DeepMining-MMV处理（包含CA-CFAR检测和牛顿优化）来融合多天线测量数据。训练数据通过仿真生成，并通过原型实验验证相位选择器。
AI.result: 原型实验表明，主动式RIS的部署能够提高呼吸的可探测性，并同时支持更高阶的调制。在没有RIS的情况下，呼吸检测是不可靠的，并且只能支持低阶调制。
AI.conclusion: 主动式RIS的部署能够显著提升生命体征（特别是呼吸率）的提取能力，并能同时支持更高阶的通信调制，从而在ISAC应用中实现性能的协同优化。
AI.translation: 我们提出了RIS-VSign系统，一个用于在集成传感与通信（ISAC）模型下提取生命体征的可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助多输入多输出正交频分复用（MIMO-OFDM）框架。该系统包括两个阶段：RIS的相位选择器和呼吸率的提取。为了减轻由同步引起的共相漂移，我们将Möbius变换差分（DMT）集成到深度学习框架DMTNet中，以联合配置多个主动式RIS单元。值得注意的是，训练数据是在仿真中生成的，没有收集真实世界测量数据，并且由此产生的相位选择器已通过实验验证。在传感方面，通过DC偏移校准和带有CA-CFAR检测和牛顿改进的DeepMining-MMV处理来融合多天线测量。原型实验表明，主动式RIS的部署提高了呼吸可探测性，同时实现了更高阶的调制；没有RIS时，呼吸检测不可靠，并且仅支持低阶调制。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为RIS-VSign的主动式RIS辅助MIMO-OFDM系统，用于在ISAC模型下提取生命体征。系统通过集成Möbius变换差分（DMT）的深度学习框架DMTNet来配置RIS单元，以解决相位漂移问题。感知阶段利用多天线测量融合技术进行呼吸率提取。实验结果表明，主动式RIS的部署显著提高了呼吸探测能力，并支持更高阶的通信调制。
AI.comments: 这项工作在ISAC领域取得了重要进展，通过主动式RIS有效地解决了生命体征提取中的相位漂移问题，并实现了感知与通信的性能协同。然而，训练数据完全依赖于仿真可能限制了模型的泛化能力，未来的研究可以考虑引入真实世界数据进行训练或微调。此外，对不同环境条件下的鲁棒性以及功耗方面的考量也值得进一步探讨。

title: On the Robustness of RSMA to Adversarial BD-RIS-Induced Interference
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: This article investigates the robustness of rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) in multi-user multiple-input single-output (MISO) systems to interference attacks against channel acquisition induced by beyond-diagonal RISs (BD-RISs). Two primary attack strategies, random and aligned interference, are proposed for fully connected and group-connected reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) architectures. Valid random reflection coefficients are generated exploiting the Takagi factorization, while potent aligned interference attacks are achieved through optimization strategies based on a quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP) reformulation followed by projections onto the unitary manifold. Our numerical findings reveal that, when perfect channel state information (CSI) is available, RSMA behaves similarly to space-division multiple access (SDMA) and thus is highly susceptible to the attack, with BD-RIS inducing severe performance loss and significantly outperforming diagonal RIS. However, under imperfect CSI, RSMA consistently demonstrates significantly greater robustness than SDMA, particularly as the system's transmit power increases.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology

title: ASSENT: Learning-Based Association Optimization for Distributed Cell-Free ISAC
comments: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Communications (ICC) 2026 (camera-ready version). Code and datasets: https://github.com/LS-Wireless/ASSENT-CellFree-ISAC
summary: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) is a key emerging 6G technology. Despite progress, ISAC still lacks scalable methods for joint AP clustering and user/target scheduling in distributed deployments under fronthaul limits. Moreover, existing ISAC solutions largely rely on centralized processing and full channel state information, limiting scalability. This paper addresses joint access point (AP) clustering, user and target scheduling, and AP mode selection in distributed cell-free ISAC systems operating with constrained fronthaul capacity. We formulate the problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) that jointly captures interference coupling, RF-chain limits, and sensing requirements, providing optimal but computationally demanding solutions. To enable real-time and scalable operation, we propose ASSENT (ASSociation and ENTity selection), a graph neural network (GNN) framework trained on MILP solutions to efficiently learn association and mode-selection policies directly from lightweight link statistics. Simulations show that ASSENT achieves near-optimal utility while accurately learning the underlying associations. Additionally, its single forward pass inference reduces decision latency compared to optimization-based methods. An open-source Python/PyTorch implementation with full datasets is provided to facilitate reproducible and extensible research in cell-free ISAC.

title: BEST-STD2.0: Balanced and Efficient Speech Tokenizer for Spoken Term Detection
summary: Fast and accurate spoken content retrieval is vital for applications such as voice search. Query-by-Example Spoken Term Detection (STD) involves retrieving matching segments from an audio database given a spoken query. Token-based STD systems, which use discrete speech representations, enable efficient search but struggle with robustness to noise and reverberation, and with inefficient token utilization. We address these challenges by proposing a noise and reverberation-augmented training strategy to improve tokenizer robustness. In addition, we introduce optimal transport-based regularization to ensure balanced token usage and enhance token efficiency. To further speed up retrieval, we adopt a TF-IDF-based search mechanism. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms STD baselines across various distortion levels while maintaining high search efficiency.

title: Spatial Interpolation of Room Impulse Responses based on Deeper Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Residual Connections
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEICE Transactions on Fundamentals of Electronics, Communications and Computer Sciences for possible publication
summary: The room impulse response (RIR) characterizes sound propagation in a room from a loudspeaker to a microphone under the linear time-invariant assumption. Estimating RIRs from a limited number of measurement points is crucial for sound propagation analysis and visualization. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have recently been introduced for accurate RIR estimation by embedding governing physical laws into deep learning models; however, the role of network depth has not been systematically investigated. In this study, we developed a deeper PINN architecture with residual connections and analyzed how network depth affects estimation performance. We further compared activation functions, including tanh and sinusoidal activations. Our results indicate that the residual PINN with sinusoidal activations achieves the highest accuracy for both interpolation and extrapolation of RIRs. Moreover, the proposed architecture enables stable training as the depth increases and yields notable improvements in estimating reflection components. These results provide practical guidelines for designing deep and stable PINNs for acoustic-inverse problems.

title: Weather Estimation for Integrated Sensing and Communication
comments: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: One of the key features of sixth-generation (6G) mobile communications will be integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). While the main goal of ISAC in standardization efforts is to detect objects, the byproducts of radar operations can be used to enable new services in 6G, such as weather sensing. Even though weather radars are the most prominent technology for weather detection and monitoring, they are expensive and usually neglect areas in close vicinity. To this end, we propose reusing the dense deployment of 6G base stations for weather sensing purposes by detecting and estimating weather conditions. We implement both a classifier and a regressor as a convolutional neural network trained across measurements with varying precipitation rates and wind speeds. We implement our approach in an ISAC proof-of-concept and conduct a multi-week experiment campaign. Experimental results show that we are able to jointly and accurately classify weather conditions with accuracies of 99.38% and 98.99% for precipitation rate and wind speed, respectively. For estimation, we obtain errors of 1.2 mm/h and 1.5 km/h, for precipitation rate and wind speed, respectively. These findings indicate that weather sensing services can be reliably deployed in 6G ISAC networks, broadening their service portfolio and boosting their market value.

title: Spatial Angular Pseudo-Derivative Search: A Single Snapshot Super-resolution Sparse DOA Scheme with Potential for Practical Application
summary: Accurate, high-resolution, and real-time DOA estimation is a cornerstone of environmental perception in automotive radar systems. While sparse signal recovery techniques offer super-resolution and high-precision estimation, their prohibitive computational complexity remains a primary bottleneck for practical deployment. This paper proposes a sparse DOA estimation scheme specifically tailored for the stringent requirements of automotive radar such as limited computational resources, restricted array apertures, and single-snapshot constraints. By introducing the concept of the spatial angular pseudo-derivative and incorporating this property as a constraint into a standard L0-norm minimization problem, we formulate an objective function that more faithfully characterizes the physical properties of the DOA problem. The associated solver, designated as the SAPD search algorithm, naturally transforms the high-dimensional optimization task into an efficient grid-search scheme. The SAPD algorithm circumvents high-order matrix inversions and computationally intensive iterations. We provide an analysis of the computational complexity and convergence properties of the proposed algorithm. Numerical simulations and experimental validation demonstrate that the SAPD method achieves a superior balance of real-time efficiency, high precision, and super-resolution, making it highly suitable for next-generation automotive radar applications.

title: Agonist-Antagonist Neural Coordination without Mechanical Coupling after Targeted Muscle Reinnervation
summary: Following limb amputation and targeted muscle reinnervation (TMR), nerves that originally innervated agonist and antagonist muscles are rerouted into one or more residual target muscles. This rerouting profoundly alters the natural mechanical coupling and afferent signalling that normally link muscle groups in intact limbs. Despite this disruption, in this study we demonstrate, using high-density intramuscular microelectrode arrays implanted in reinnervated muscles of three TMR participants, that motor units (MUs) associated with agonist and antagonist tasks remain functionally coupled. Specifically, over 40% of motor units active during agonist tasks were also recruited during the corresponding antagonist tasks, even though no visual feedback on antagonist neural activity was provided. These motor units exhibited significantly different firing rates depending on their functional role. These results provide the first motor-unit-level evidence that the central nervous system preserves coordinated agonist-antagonist control after TMR and inform restorative surgical strategies and prosthetic systems capable of regulating both limb kinematics and dynamics based on agonist-antagonist commands interplay.

title: Phase Transitions in Collective Damage of Civil Structures under Natural Hazards
summary: The fate of cities under natural hazards depends not only on hazard intensity but also on the coupling of structural damage, a collective process that remains poorly understood. Here we show that urban structural damage exhibits phase-transition phenomena. As hazard intensity increases, the system can shift abruptly from a largely safe to a largely damaged state, analogous to a first-order phase transition in statistical physics. Higher diversity in the building portfolio smooths this transition, but multiscale damage clustering traps the system in an extended critical-like regime (analogous to a Griffiths phase), suppressing the emergence of a more predictable disordered (Gaussian) phase. These phenomenological patterns are characterized by a random-field Ising model, with the external field, disorder strength, and temperature interpreted as the effective hazard demand, structural diversity, and modeling uncertainty, respectively. Applying this framework to real urban inventories reveals that widely used engineering modeling practices can shift urban damage patterns between synchronized and volatile regimes, systematically biasing exceedance-based risk metrics by up to 50% under moderate earthquakes ($M_w \approx 5.5$--$6.0$), equivalent to a several-fold gap in repair costs. This phase-aware description turns the collective behavior of civil infrastructure damage into actionable diagnostics for urban risk assessment and planning.

title: Physical Activity Trajectories Preceding Incident Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis Using Consumer Wearable Devices in the All of Us Research Program: Case-Control Study
summary:
Low physical activity is a known risk factor for major depressive disorder (MDD), but changes in activity before a first clinical diagnosis remain unclear, especially using long-term objective measurements. This study characterized trajectories of wearable-measured physical activity during the year preceding incident MDD diagnosis.
  We conducted a retrospective nested case-control study using linked electronic health record and Fitbit data from the All of Us Research Program. Adults with at least 6 months of valid wearable data in the year before diagnosis were eligible. Incident MDD cases were matched to controls on age, sex, body mass index, and index time (up to four controls per case). Daily step counts and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) were aggregated into monthly averages. Linear mixed-effects models compared trajectories from 12 months before diagnosis to diagnosis. Within cases, contrasts identified when activity first significantly deviated from levels 12 months prior.
  The cohort included 4,104 participants (829 cases and 3,275 controls; 81.7% women; median age 48.4 years). Compared with controls, cases showed consistently lower activity and significant downward trajectories in both step counts and MVPA during the year before diagnosis (P < 0.001). Significant declines appeared about 4 months before diagnosis for step counts and 5 months for MVPA. Exploratory analyses suggested subgroup differences, including steeper declines in men, greater intensity reductions at older ages, and persistently low activity among individuals with obesity.
  Sustained within-person declines in physical activity emerged months before incident MDD diagnosis. Longitudinal wearable monitoring may provide early signals to support risk stratification and earlier intervention.

title: Design and Analysis Strategies for Pooling in High Throughput Screening: Application to the Search for a New Anti-Microbial
summary: A major public health issue is the growing resistance of bacteria to antibiotics. An important part of the needed response is the discovery and development of new antimicrobial strategies. These require the screening of potential new drugs, typically accomplished using high-throughput screening (HTS). Traditionally, HTS is performed by examining one compound per well, but a more efficient strategy pools multiple compounds per well. In this work, we study several recently proposed pooling construction methods, as well as a variety of pooled high-throughput screening analysis methods, in order to provide guidance to practitioners on which methods to use. This is done in the context of an application of the methods to the search for new drugs to combat bacterial infection. We discuss both an extensive pilot study as well as a small screening campaign, and highlight both the successes and challenges of the pooling approach.

title: Competing Risk Analysis in Cardiovascular Outcome Trials: A Simulation Comparison of Cox and Fine-Gray Models
summary: Cardiovascular outcome trials commonly face competing risks when non-CV death prevents observation of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). While Cox proportional hazards models treat competing events as independent censoring, Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard models explicitly handle competing risks, targeting different estimands. This simulation study using bivariate copula models systematically varies competing event rates (0.5%-5% annually), treatment effects on competing events (50% reduction to 50% increase), and correlation structures to compare these approaches. At competing event rates typical of CV outcome trials (~1% annually), Cox and Fine-Gray produce nearly identical hazard ratio estimates regardless of correlation strength or treatment effect direction. Substantial divergence occurs only with high competing rates and directionally discordant treatment effects, though neither estimator provides unbiased estimates of true marginal hazard ratios under these conditions. In typical CV trial settings with low competing event rates, Cox models remain appropriate for primary analysis due to superior interpretability. Pre-specified Cox models should not be abandoned for competing risk methods. Importantly, Fine-Gray models do not constitute proper sensitivity analyses to Cox models per ICH E9(R1), as they target different estimands rather than testing assumptions. As supplementary analysis, cumulative incidence using Aalen-Johansen estimator can provide transparency about competing risk impact. Under high competing-risk scenarios, alternative approaches such as inverse probability of censoring weighting, multiple imputation, or inclusion of all-cause mortality in primary endpoints warrant consideration.

title: Introducing the b-value: combining unbiased and biased estimators from a sensitivity analysis perspective
summary: In empirical research, when we have multiple estimators for the same parameter of interest, a central question arises: how do we combine unbiased but less precise estimators with biased but more precise ones to improve the inference? Under this setting, the point estimation problem has attracted considerable attention. In this paper, we focus on a less studied inference question: how can we conduct valid statistical inference in such settings with unknown bias? We propose a strategy to combine unbiased and biased estimators from a sensitivity analysis perspective. We derive a sequence of confidence intervals indexed by the magnitude of the bias, which enable researchers to assess how conclusions vary with the bias levels. Importantly, we introduce the notion of the b-value, a critical value of the unknown maximum relative bias at which combining estimators does not yield a significant result. We apply this strategy to three canonical combined estimators: the precision-weighted estimator, the pretest estimator, and the soft-thresholding estimator. For each estimator, we characterize the sequence of confidence intervals and determine the bias threshold at which the conclusion changes. Based on the theory, we recommend reporting the b-value based on the soft-thresholding estimator and its associated confidence intervals, which are robust to unknown bias and achieve the lowest worst-case risk among the alternatives.

title: Two-way Clustering Robust Variance Estimator in Quantile Regression Models
summary: We study inference for linear quantile regression with two-way clustered data. Using a separately exchangeable array framework and a projection decomposition of the quantile score, we characterize regime-dependent convergence rates and establish a self-normalized Gaussian approximation. We propose a two-way cluster-robust sandwich variance estimator with a kernel-based density ``bread'' and a projection-matched ``meat'', and prove consistency and validity of inference in Gaussian regimes. We also show an impossibility result for uniform inference in a non-Gaussian interaction regime.

title: Scattering and sputtering on the lunar surface; Insights from negative ions observed at the surface
summary:
Context. Airless planetary bodies are directly exposed to solar wind ions, which can scatter or become implanted upon impact with the regolith-covered surface, while also sputtering surface atoms.
  Aims. We construct a semi-analytical model for the scattering of ions of hundreds of eV and the sputtering of surface atoms, both resulting in the emission of negative ions from the lunar surface. Our model contains a novel description of the scattering process that is physics-based and constrained by observations.
  Methods. We use data from the Negative Ions at the Lunar Surface (NILS) instrument on the Chang'e-6 lander to update prior knowledge of ion scattering and sputtering from lunar regolith through Bayesian inference.
  Results. Our model shows good agreement with the NILS data. A precipitating solar wind proton has roughly a 22% chance of scattering from the lunar surface in any charge state, and about an 8% chance of sputtering a surface hydrogen atom. The resulting ratio of scattered to sputtered hydrogen flux is eta_sc / eta_sp = 1.5 for a proton speed of 300 km/s. We find a high probability (7-20%) that a hydrogen atom leaves the surface negatively charged. The angular emission distributions at near-grazing angles for both scattered and sputtered fluxes are controlled by surface roughness. Our model also indicates significant inelastic energy losses for hydrogen interacting with the regolith, suggesting a longer effective path length than previously assumed. Finally, we estimate a surface binding energy of 5.5 eV, consistent with the observations.
  Conclusions. Our model describes the scattering and sputtering of particles of any charge state from any homogeneous, multi-species surface. Using NILS data, we successfully applied the model to update our understanding of solar wind interacting with lunar regolith, and the emission of negative hydrogen ions.

title: The Dataset of Daily Air Quality for the Years 2013-2023 in Italy
summary: Air quality and climate are major issues in Italian society and lie at the intersection of many research fields, including public health and policy planning. There is an increasing need for readily available, easily accessible, ready-to-use and well-documented datasets on air quality and climate. In this paper, we present the GRINS AQCLIM dataset, created under the GRINS project framework covering the Italian domain for an extensive time period. It includes daily statistics (e.g., minimum, quartiles, mean, median and maximum) for a collection of air pollutant concentrations and climate variables at the locations of the 700+ available monitoring stations. Input data are retrieved from the European Environmental Agency and Copernicus Programme and were subjected to multiple processing steps to ensure their reliability and quality. These steps include automatic procedures for fixing raw files, manual inspection of stations information, the detection and removal of anomalies, and the temporal harmonisation on a daily basis. Datasets are hosted on Zenodo under open-access principles.

title: From Chain-Ladder to Individual Claims Reserving
summary: The chain-ladder (CL) method is the most widely used claims reserving technique in non-life insurance. This manuscript introduces a novel approach to computing the CL reserves based on a fundamental restructuring of the data utilization for the CL prediction procedure. Instead of rolling forward the cumulative claims with estimated CL factors, we estimate multi-period factors that project the latest observations directly to the ultimate claims. This alternative perspective on CL reserving creates a natural pathway for the application of machine learning techniques to individual claims reserving. As a proof of concept, we present a small-scale real data application employing neural networks for individual claims reserving.

title: A Wiener Chaos Approach to Martingale Modelling and Implied Volatility Calibration
summary: Calibration to a surface of option prices requires specifying a suitably flexible martingale model for the discounted asset price under a risk-neutral measure. Assuming Brownian noise and mean-square integrability, we construct an over-parameterized model based on the martingale representation theorem. In particular, we approximate the terminal value of the martingale via a truncated Wiener--chaos expansion and recover the intermediate dynamics by computing the corresponding conditional expectations. Using the Hermite-polynomial formulation of the Wiener chaos, we obtain easily implementable expressions that enable fast calibration to a target implied-volatility surface. We illustrate the flexibility and expressive power of the resulting model through numerical experiments on both simulated and real market data.

title: Stackelberg Equilibria in Monopoly Insurance Markets with Probability Weighting
summary: We study Stackelberg Equilibria (Bowley optima) in a monopolistic centralized sequential-move insurance market, with a profit-maximizing insurer who sets premia using a distortion premium principle, and a single policyholder who seeks to minimize a distortion risk measure. We show that equilibria are characterized as follows: In equilibrium, the optimal indemnity function exhibits a layer-type structure, providing full insurance over any loss layer on which the policyholder is more pessimistic than the insurer's pricing functional about tail losses; and no insurance coverage over loss layers on which the policyholder is less pessimistic than the insurer's pricing functional about tail losses. In equilibrium, the optimal pricing distortion function is determined by the policyholder's degree of risk aversion, whereby prices never exceed the policyholder's marginal willingness to insure tail losses. Moreover, we show that both the insurance coverage and the insurer's expected profit increase with the policyholder's degree of risk aversion. Additionally, and echoing recent work in the literature, we show that equilibrium contracts are Pareto efficient, but they do not induce a welfare gain to the policyholder. Conversely, any Pareto-optimal contract that leaves no welfare gain to the policyholder can be obtained as an equilibrium contract. Finally, we consider a few examples of interest that recover some existing results in the literature as special cases of our analysis.

title: An Axiomatic Risk-Reward Framework for Sustainable Investing
summary: Continued interest in sustainable investing calls for an axiomatic approach to measures of risk and reward that focus not only on financial returns, but also on measures of environmental and social sustainability, i.e. environmental, social, and governance (ESG) scores. We propose definitions for ESG-coherent risk measures and ESG reward-risk ratios based on functions of bivariate random variables that are applied to financial returns and real-time ESG scores, extending the traditional univariate measures to the ESG case. We provide examples and present an empirical analysis in which the ESG-coherent risk measures and ESG reward-risk ratios are used to rank stocks.

title: Performative Market Making
summary: Financial models do not merely analyse markets, but actively shape them. This effect, known as performativity, describes how financial theories and the subsequent actions based on them influence market processes, by creating self-fulfilling prophecies. Although discussed in the literature on economic sociology, this deeply rooted phenomenon lacks mathematical formulation in financial markets. Our paper closes this gap by breaking down the canonical separation of diffusion processes between the description of the market environment and the financial model. We do that by embedding the model in the process itself, creating a closed feedback loop, and demonstrate how prices change towards greater conformity to the prevailing financial model used in the market. We further show, with closed-form solutions and machine learning, how a performative market maker can reverse engineer the current dominant strategies in the market and effectively arbitrage them while maintaining competitive quotes and superior P&L.
